joinKey: (documentId, packId, leftOccurrence, rightOccurrence); H2 anchor-scoped duplicate decisions are retained and disagreement is explicit
populationScope: Five explicitly frozen RESOURCE_BOUNDED_SOURCE_PACKING_V1 packs (one per document); H2 calls were issued for each G2A HAS primary and its owned-pack tail. This is not a whole-document or corpus-wide H2 census.

inputs.g2a: complete G2A ledger over F1 ESTABLISHES_STRUCTURE primaries

statusDefinitions.PAIRABLE_EDGE: G2A has a decision for right and all overlapping H2 decisions agree on one boundary; outcome is CONFLICT or NON_CONFLICT.
statusDefinitions.UNPAIRED_NO_G2A_RIGHT: At least one H2 judgment exists but G2A has no decision for right.
statusDefinitions.UNPAIRED_NO_H2: G2A has a decision for right but no H2 judgment exists for this adjacent edge.
statusDefinitions.UNPAIRED_NO_G2A_AND_NO_H2: Neither G2A(right) nor H2(left,right) is present; reported separately so edge accounting is exhaustive.
statusDefinitions.H2_OVERLAP_DISAGREEMENT: H2 issued multiple anchor-scoped judgments for one source edge and they disagree; not pairable and never tie-broken.
statusDefinitions.NON_CONFLICT: PAIRABLE_EDGE that does not meet the conflict predicate.

denominator.qualificationInterpretation: Observed denominator for these five selected packs only; not a random corpus sample or general H3 qualification population.

coverage.perCallRawIntegrity: Every raw response and SSE hash verified; each exact manifest request and issued edge set matched.
coverage.overlapRule: No candidate authority, Gold, majority, first-anchor preference, or tie-break is used.
